title: Check that card rules do not favour American Express-style schemes
action: Have the ACCC and the Reserve Bank assess whether interchange and surcharging rules give three-party card schemes an advantage over the regulated schemes, and regulate their merchant fees if the distortion is significant.
why: If rules lower costs for eftpos, Mastercard and Visa but not for schemes outside the regulation, merchants and customers may be steered towards the more expensive cards.

evidence.source: Competition in the Australian Financial System
evidence.quote: whether current or recommended interchange fee regulation favours three-party card schemes and, if such a distortion exists, whether it is significant enough to require further regulatory intervention
